tools.name: list_protocols
tools.description: Free on testnet. Every row in the human-verified Ledger (protocols, platforms, wallets, stablecoins): name, short names/aliases and status only. Use a name from here with get_status or get_status_detail.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Free on testnet. Automated scan, not human-verified. Scan-only quick read of whether AI agents can discover and buy from a website. Returns the engine's report as-is: scanner_version and scan_id ("v4"), report.score (scan-only), report.band (can be 'Partly assessed'), report.coverage, report.summary

tools.name: query_ledger
tools.description: Free on testnet. Free-text keyword search over the human-verified Ledger (protocols, platforms, wallets, stablecoins). Returns up to 5 matching row NAMES with status, a relevance score and which fields matched (exact_name, name, steward, status, text). It returns names, not answers: call get_status

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Free on testnet. Status of one Ledger row (protocol, platform, wallet or stablecoin) from the human-verified Ledger: headline, status, last verified date and ONE source URL. If the name is not in the Ledger: result="unknown" plus up to 3 did_you_mean names (never a guessed answer). Call list_protoco

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Free on testnet. Recent verified Ledger changes since a date (last 30 days, max 5 items): headline, status, date, one source.

tools.name: get_status_detail
tools.description: Free on testnet (no payment, no wallet needed). Fuller answer for ONE Ledger row (protocol, platform, wallet or stablecoin): headline, status (authoritative), maturity (a plain-English stage derived from status, never contradicts it), steward, what_this_means (the detail after the headline, omitted
